subject: [Action Needed] Finvest p95 spike after model-13c-quant-v2 deploy
messages:
From: Carl Hudson <carl.hudson@finvest.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: p95 jump after this morning's model change - urgent

Monica,

We pushed live to model-13c-quant-v2 at 07:30 PT for a test cohort and immediately started seeing p95 latency jump from ~210ms to ~780ms for our predictive routing calls. This is outside our SLA (p95 <= 300ms) and impacting user flows. Both request volume and payloads are unchanged.

Attached is a CSV snapshot of the latency buckets and a short perf graph. Our SREs are standing by — can you confirm whether Redwood rolled any kernel/quantization changes today that could explain this? We need a mitigation plan within 30 minutes or we will route traffic away.

- Carl
Finvest, Director of Platform Engineering

[Attachment: finvest_p95_snapshot_20290620.csv]
[Attachment: perf_graphs_13c_quant_v2.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-20T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: p95 jump after this morning's model change - urgent

Rishi / Priyom — FYI, Finvest is seeing a severe p95 increase immediately after the 13c-quant-v2 rollout to their cohort. Data attached. They are within their SLA window; this looks like a regression tied to the quantized variant we promoted.

Immediate ask: can we (1) enable per-account variant fallback routing for Finvest to send them to model-13c-fp16-v1 (known stable) and (2) prepare a rollback plan for the quant variant if fallback does not reduce p95 within 20-30 minutes?

Please include the minimal steps, expected blast radius, and who needs to sign off on rollback. Neha — tagging you for 1) approval threshold for a rollback that will affect hosted customers, and 2) whether we should offer Finvest a credit if rollback is required.

Thanks,
Monica
Head of Customer Escalations, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: mitigation_playbook.md]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-20T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: p95 jump after this morning's model change - urgent

Short answer: yes, we can do per-account fallback routing immediately.

Plan proposal (30 min rapid mitigation):
- T+0: Enable routing rule for Finvest to map traffic for their API key(s) to model-13c-fp16-v1 (stable) — no infra change, pure routing policy update. This should reduce p95 quickly if quant variant is the cause.
- T+10: Monitor p50/p95/p99 and request success rates.
- T+20: If p95 remains >350ms, initiate rollback of model-13c-quant-v2 for all hostnames using the canary tag (rollback to previous artifact). Rollback procedure is standard — will require approval from Neha for hosted-wide rollback. Expected rollback window 3-7 minutes to complete; some requests may see transient errors during the switch.
- T+30: If rollback occurs, keep fallback routing for Finvest until we validate stability for 2 hours.

Risks/blast radius: rollback affects all tenants currently pinned to 13c-quant-v2; routing change is per-account and limited to Finvest. Fallback will increase cost per token slightly (fp16 vs quant) but preserves SLA.

I will trigger the routing change now on my mark. Priyom — can you stage the rollback artifact and pre-populate the rollback runbook in SUP-4271?

- Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-20T08:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: p95 jump after this morning's model change - urgent

On it. I have staged the previous stable artifact (13c-quant-v1 and model-13c-fp16-v1) and created SUP-4271 with the rollback checklist and health checks: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUP-4271.

Commands I will run once we decide:
1) Toggle routing: redwood-router update --account finvest --variant model-13c-fp16-v1 --reason "p95 spike 2029-06-20"
2) If rollback needed: redwood-deploy rollback --artifact model-13c-quant-v1 --tag canary --parallel 2

Monitoring endpoints: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example/perf-13c-quant — I uploaded the perf traces and the kernel profile.

I recommend enabling the fallback routing now (Rishi can flip) and monitoring for 15 minutes. If p95 does not settle below 320ms, we should escalate to rollback.

- Priyom
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Carl Hudson <carl.hudson@finvest.com>, Finvest SRE Team <sre@finvest.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-20T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: p95 jump after this morning's model change - urgent

Carl — thank you for the alert and the attachments. We are implementing a per-account routing fallback for Finvest now to send your traffic to model-13c-fp16-v1. Expect the switch within 2 minutes.

If the p95 does not drop below 320ms within 20 minutes we will trigger a full rollback of model-13c-quant-v2. Neha (cc) — please confirm approval for rollback if we reach the threshold. If approved, we will execute the rollback and keep Finvest on the FP16 variant until we validate stability for 2 hours. We will also prepare a credit proposal if this is customer-impacting.

I will update this thread with metrics once the routing change completes.

— Monica
Head of Customer Escalations, Redwood Inference

- Carl
